newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSA LEASING SIGNS SYNDICATED LOAN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSA LEASING SIGNS SYNDICATED LOAN DEAL.

text.p: Hansa Leasing, the leasing arm of Estonia's largest bank Hansapank , on Wednesday signed a deal to take a syndicated loan of 50 million marks with a group of 13 banks, led by Bankgesellschaft Berlin Group.
Other key arrangers were Citibank and Enskilda Bank, Hansabank-Latvija, where the deal was signed, said in a statement.
"Hansa Leasing plans to use the funds for refinancing and for new leasing and factoring operations in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania," Hansabank-Latvija said in a statement.
The consolidated assets of Hansa Leasing are 2.08 billion kroons and its net profit in June was 44.4 million kroons.
Of this, the leasing operations in Estonia have assets of 2.01 billion kroons, in Latvia assets were at 342.1 million kroons and in Lithuania 189.2 million kroons.
